[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} [[Azure Remains]] are a type of [[trophy]] item dropped by [[Azure Shadow]]s in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]. They are said to be able to dampen sounds and are, therefore, occasionally used on shoes in the Southern Shiverpeaks to avoid gaining the attention of [[Wurm]]s. == Acquisition == * [[Prophecies]] ** [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] *** [[Azure Shadow]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Azure Remains#Drop research|here]].'' ==Farming== [[File:Azure Remains farm.jpg|thumb|Farm route in Witman's Folly]] ====[[Witman's Folly]]==== Enter from [[Port Sledge]]. The southeast corner of the zone contains about 20 Azure Shadows along with the [[imp]] [[boss]]es [[Maak Frostfriend]] and [[Sniik Hungrymind]] (be wary of that all except the ones around the imp bosses are pop-up groups). ====[[Talus Chute]]==== Enter from [[Camp Rankor]], are 2 groups of Azure Shadows and a pop-up group with some Avicara groups in the middle. == Collectors == {{:Hoknil the Lesser/Collector}} {{:Vania Sewell/Collector armor}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|7th June 2010 and 9th January 2012|Dreadnought's Drift|2 [[Azure Remains]]}} == Notes == * The collector [[Hoknil the Lesser]] trades 5 Azure Remains for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is three times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Tian]] for his dessert at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival.
